ROW.COLUMN: Instructions specify the details about how trades will be cleared and settled, and consequently direct flows of funds and securities into and out of accounts. This scenario identifies cases where a customer makes frequent changes to instructions. This is an unusual business practice and may be used to disguise the origin of assets by moving them through different institutions and jurisdictions.

Primary Rule of this scenario (IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Frc_Prd_1) provides the strongest filtering factor for the pattern to make functioning of next Sub-rules more efficient. It provides Frequency-Period filtering and apply all TSD filters too. The main idea of this dataset is to weed out Customers, whose Accounts have not experienced instruction changes since the last scenario run, so only Customers, whose accounts experienced instruction changes during Frequency Period will be considered during father stages.
The next Sub-Rule, based on the IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Chng_Ct_1 Dataset , provides calculations for all values, needed to realize alert-generation logic in the following Check-Point. Dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Chng_Ct_1 is build on the base of Dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Aug_Ins.
The last pair of datasets, following the Check-Point doesn't take tart in behavior-detection logic and just provide data for augmentation Instructions.

It's used also as a base dataset for dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Chng_Ct_1

--Scenario Name --Frequent Changes to Instructions --Scenario Short Name --Frqnt Chngs to Instructions --Scenario Class --Money Laundering - Institutional (IML) --Scenario Focus --Customer (CU) ------------------------------------------- -- Dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Aug_Ins -- ------------------------------------------- -- (114001899) -- Produce all instruction records that are pertinent to the alert -- -- Will be used to get Instructions Support Data -- -- It's used also as a base dataset for dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Chng_Ct_1 -- --Bug 29709398 with Curr_Intsr as (select distinct i.INSTR_SEQ_ID INSTR_SEQ_ID, -- Dataset Key ID i.ACCT_INTRL_ID ACCT_INTRL_ID, c.CUST_INTRL_ID CUST_INTRL_ID, -- Focal Entity -- Next elements don't really need for this dataset role -- They need for dataset IML_Frq_Chng_to_Instr_Chng_Ct, -- which is created on the base of this one c.CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB CUST_EFCTV_RISK_NB, -- for Effective risk level scoring binding a.ACCT_SEQ_ID ACCT_SEQ_ID, i.DATA_DUMP_DT DATA_DUMP_DT, i.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, i.PRDCT_TYPE_CD PRDCT_TYPE_CD, i.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, i.INSTR_TYPE_CD INSTR_TYPE_CD from @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i, @MINER@.ACCT a, @MINER@.CUST c, @MANTAS@.KDD_CAL cal, @MINER@.INSTRUCTION i1
where a.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i.ACCT_INTRL_ID and c.CUST_INTRL_ID = a.PRMRY_CUST_INTRL_ID and cal.CLNDR_DAY_AGE = 0 and cal.CLNDR_NM = 'SYSCAL' and i.DATA_DUMP_DT > add_days(cal.CLNDR_DT, -@Look_Back_Period) and i.DATA_DUMP_DT <= cal.CLNDR_DT and i.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'S' and a.ACCT_STAT_CD = 'A' and (@All_Acct_Type_Fl = 'Y' or a.ACCT_TYPE1_CD in (@Incl_Acct_Type_Lst)) -- standing instruction record to be a change only if it replaces another -- standing instruction in the same account with the same product type and i1.ACCT_INTRL_ID = i.ACCT_INTRL_ID and i1.INSTR_TYPE_CD = 'S' -- Standing instruction and nvl(i1.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_CTGRY_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') and nvl(i1.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') = nvl(i.PRDCT_SUB_TYPE_CD, 'no_data') -- If the situation when there were more then one changes in one day is possible -- then we need to take into account those instructions -- (See KDS00023950 for more details) and (i1.DATA_DUMP_DT < i.DATA_DUMP_DT or (i1.DATA_DUMP_DT = i.DATA_DUMP_DT and i1.INSTR_SEQ_ID < i.INSTR_SEQ_ID) )
